summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Prudential plc reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. The filing details votes on standard agenda items including the receipt of annual accounts, approval of directors' remuneration, re-election of directors, reappointment of auditors, and renewal of authorities for share allotment and buybacks. All resolutions were passed comfortably, with the lowest 'for' vote being 88.72% for Director Jeremy Anderson. This is a standard governance disclosure with no special-situation event; it is a routine AGM result report.
